headline: Segunda coin flip: Celta II 35.1%, draw 30.4%, Tenerife 34.5%
summary: The market sees a genuine three-way split in Segunda. Celta de Vigo II are the narrow favourite at 35.1%, the draw sits at 30.4% and Tenerife at 34.5%, with the handicap on level ball and the home side 50.5% on the +0 line. The goals market leans slightly under: Over 2.25 is 51.9% and the fair total 2.32, a 1.3-point drift on five books since tracking began, partly given back by 09:31. BTTS Yes is flat at 53.3% across seven books and is a separate market, not corroboration.

voices.scout: But look at goals. The sharp book took Over two and a quarter down to about fifty-two per cent, fair total from two point three seven to two point three two. Nobody had to do that — no injuries, no team news. That's someone leaning under.
voices.sceptic: Leaning? The sharp book cut at six forty-six, then it was back to fifty-two point two by nine thirty-one. Five books quote that line. Consensus fell further than the sharp book did. That's a one-point-three per cent wobble on five books, not an informed move.
voices.gaffer: Right. The model's best candidate sat at minus zero point five per cent, well under its own two per cent bar. This tape says coin flip with a wobble — and you don't force a call on a coin flip.
